blurb: Guests take sightseeing boat tours around New York Harbor to see landmarks such as the Statue of Liberty, Ellis Island, Manhattan skyline, Empire State Building, and One World Trade Center. Tours include live guides and offer both indoor and outdoor seating. Various themed cruises are available including fall foliage, Thanksgiving, sunset, and city lights cruises.
extraNote: Cruises sail regardless of weather conditions · Tickets are non-refundable · Pier 40, 353 West St, New York, NY 10014
